issue.title: Simplify music player metadata and control layout
issue.description:
Refine the music-player gallery composition into a cleaner, more conventional media-player layout.

Owner direction:

* Simplify the song metadata so the composition shows only:
  * song artwork;
  * song title;
  * artist;
  * favorite/heart icon on the right.
* Remove the extra metadata concept entirely across all song states, not just the currently visible song.

Remove conceptually from the music player:

* "NOW PLAYING"
* Side A / Side B or equivalent album-side metadata
* track sequence/index values such as 01 / 03
* any equivalent secondary metadata field used only for that concept

This cleanup should apply across every song/state represented by the composition.

Header/content layout:

* Keep song artwork on the left.
* Keep song title and artist beside it.
* Keep only the heart/favorite icon on the far right.
* Do not add replacement metadata.

Timeline:

* Keep elapsed time and remaining time labels.
* Change those time labels from Mono typography to Sans/Body typography.
* Move the time labels above the progress slider rather than below it.
* Elapsed time aligns left.
* Remaining time aligns right.
* Preserve the current progress interaction if it is already lightweight and geometry-stable.

Bottom control row:
Use five icon-only controls in this order:

1. Shuffle
2. Previous / Back
3. Play / Pause
4. Next / Forward
5. Repeat

Control layout:

* All five controls should use equal-sized button/touch targets.
* Distribute them evenly across the full control row.
* Keep icon sizing consistent.
* Play/Pause may remain visually emphasized if desired, but should still belong to the same control system and spacing rhythm.
* Preserve accessible names for every icon-only control.

Interaction:

* Keep interaction local and lightweight.
* Basic play/pause, track navigation, shuffle, repeat, favorite, and progress-state changes are acceptable.
* No real audio streaming/network integration is required.
* Interaction must not materially change card height or gallery geometry.

Design-system constraints:

* Keep styling driven by Personal UI semantic tokens.
* Use Heading / Body / Mono roles appropriately; timeline time labels should specifically use Sans/Body rather than Mono.
* Preserve light/dark behavior.
* Reuse existing Button/Slider/Icon primitives where appropriate.
* Do not introduce a new public audio-player primitive solely for this composition unless the abstraction is genuinely reusable.

Do not:

* change gallery placement/order in this ticket;
* add album-side/track-number metadata back in another form;
* add extra labels around the controls;
* add workflow-heavy playback logic;
* introduce network/audio service dependencies;
* change unrelated gallery compositions.

Acceptance:

* Music player shows only artwork, song title, artist, and heart/favorite icon in its primary metadata area.
* "NOW PLAYING" is removed.
* Side A / Side B metadata is removed across all song states.
* Track index/number metadata such as 01 / 03 is removed across all song states.
* Elapsed and remaining time labels use Sans/Body typography.
* Time labels appear above the progress slider.
* Bottom controls are Shuffle / Previous / Play-Pause / Next / Repeat in that order.
* All five controls use equal-sized touch targets and are evenly distributed across the row.
* Play/Pause remains clearly understandable and accessible.
* Light/dark/theme-token responsiveness remains intact.
* No overflow, focus-order, keyboard, accessibility, or responsive regression.
